summary: @MarcelleHaddix We can brainstorm after you get a few days off. I am helping to organize an @indiewebcamp online and will have a better feel, but the on the ground #IndieWeb events are always 100% free and cost about >500 (all donations) to run.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @MarcelleHaddix We can brainstorm after you get a few days off. I am helping to organize an @indiewebcamp online and will have a better feel, but the on the ground #IndieWeb events are always 100% free and cost about >500 (all donations) to run.
